subject: Re: Acme Corp POC Kickoff — Scope & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmecorp.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Corp POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Hi Jordan / Sanjay —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our kickoff and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Current chatbot has high latency on long documents (~2.5–3s per response) and spikes during peak queries
- Embedding-based retrieval produces noisy results for multi-section docs (precision issues)
- Cost per query is high due to lack of batching and repeated model calls

Goals for the POC (success metrics):
- Latency: 90th percentile < 800ms for typical 512-token responses under target load
- Retrieval QA: Increase top-3 precision on our benchmark prompt set from 62% to >=78%
- Cost: Reduce per-interaction token cost by 30% vs current baseline through batching and caching
- Stability: No >5% error rate during a sustained 10k-query/day workload

Scope & deliverables (4-week pilot):
1) Model serving and routing config for two candidate models (open-weights)
2) Integration of prefix caching and continuous batching for hit-rate improvements
3) Retrieval/eval pipeline using your 500-document corpus + a 200-prompt test set
4) Weekly eval report with latency/cost/precision metrics and qualitative failure cases

Owners & roles:
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole — program lead, exec updates
- Redwood Eng (technical lead): Rishi Malhotra — infra & model onboarding
- Redwood CS: Neha Kapoor — pilot ops, onboarding, metrics reviews
- Acme technical lead: Jordan Lee — access & data provisioning

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): Access + S3 paths + service account, sign SOW
- Week 1: Model selection, baseline runs, prompt set evaluation
- Week 2: Integration of caching/batching; run perf tests
- Week 3: Quality tuning, run full eval, collect feedback
- Week 4: Final report + recommendations + next steps for production

Access/setup checklist (action items for Acme):
- Provide AWS account ID and an S3 path with a read-only role for the pilot data
- Add rishi.malhotra@redwood.com as an IAM principal or provide temporary credentials
- Share sample prompt set and any relevant PII handling constraints

Attachments included: acme-poc-mop-v1.pdf (MOP), acme-prompt-set-v1.csv (test prompts)

Next steps / asks from Acme:
1) Confirm the success metrics above and timeline by EOD Wed (May 12)
2) Share AWS account ID + S3 path and preferred contact for security onboarding
3) Sign SOW we’ll send via DocuSign (expected later today)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invites once we confirm access.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: acme-poc-mop-v1.pdf, acme-prompt-set-v1.csv
